name: Resurgence of the Storm
summary: Resurgence of the Storm is a Starcraft 2 arcade map that is currently being developed by zeroLamberg inside the Starcraft 2 Galaxy Editor. It is designed as a successor/recreation for Heroes of the Storm. It launched with 15 playable heroes, most of which are redesigned versions of their Heroes counterparts.
